description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2920251209647 STARTER, ENGINE,ELEC: Line 0001 Qty 7 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0053 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
